path.description: The path to create the component.

name.x-prompt: What should be the name of the container component?

inlineStyle.description: Specifies if the style will be in the ts file.

inlineTemplate.description: Specifies if the template will be in the ts file.

prefix.description: The prefix to apply to generated selectors.

style.description: The file extension or preprocessor to use for style files.

skipTests.description: When true, does not create test files.

flat.description: When true, creates the files in the path directly; when false (Angular's default), creates them in a folder named after the component.

skipImport.description: Flag to skip the module import.

selector.description: The selector to use for the component.

module.description: Allows specification of the declaring module.

export.description: Specifies if declaring module exports the component.

state.description: Specifies the path to the state exports.

stateInterface.description: The interface the state file exports; with --state, the injected store is typed as Store<fromStore.<name>>.

testDepth.description: Specifies whether to create a unit test or an integration test.

standalone.description: Whether the generated component is standalone.

displayBlock.description: Specifies if the style will contain :host { display: block; }.
